en.title: White House confirms Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral summit in China, Iran and nuclear arms on agenda
en.dek: US President Donald Trump will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen on November 19, according to the White House.
facts: White House confirms upcoming trilateral summit in China on November 19 between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping
US officials stated discussions will focus on nuclear arms reduction and the war against Iran
US officials said talks on Ukraine will continue separately from the summit
Democratic US senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons told Elon Musk to preserve records related to SpaceX restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield services
Senators set a November 30 deadline for confirmation of the preservation of records
Ukrainian forces stated that the military-grade Starshield system is vital for frontline communications and drone operations
body: The White House confirmed that US President Donald Trump will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen on November 19 for a trilateral summit.
US officials stated that discussions will focus on nuclear arms reduction and the war against Iran, while noting that talks on Ukraine will continue separately from the summit.
Democratic US senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons told Elon Musk to preserve records related to SpaceX restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield services.

Senators set a November 30 deadline for confirmation of the preservation of these records, citing the importance of the military-grade Starshield system for Ukrainian frontline communications and drone operations.
The Kyiv Post reported that Ukrainian forces consider the Starshield system vital for frontline communications and drone operations, according to reports.
The Hindu reported that Democratic U.S. senators ordered Musk to preserve records on Ukraine Starlink access, citing the strategic importance of the system.
en.context: The developments occur against a backdrop of ongoing US-Russia-China diplomatic engagement and increasing congressional scrutiny of SpaceX's satellite technology support for Ukraine.

en.headline: US senators order Musk to preserve SpaceX records on Ukraine Starlink access
en.body: Democratic US senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons told Elon Musk to preserve records related to SpaceX restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield services. Ukrainian forces stated that the military-grade Starshield system is vital for frontline communications and drone operations, according to reports. Senators set a November 30 deadline for confirmation of the preservation.

es.headline: Senadores de EE. UU. ordenan a Musk conservar los registros de SpaceX sobre el acceso a Starlink en Ucrania
es.body: Los senadores demócratas estadounidenses Jeanne Shaheen y Chris Coons ordenaron a Elon Musk conservar los registros relacionados con las restricciones de SpaceX a los servicios Starlink y Starshield en Ucrania. Las fuerzas ucranianas afirmaron que el sistema Starshield, de uso militar, es vital para las comunicaciones en el frente y las operaciones con drones, según los informes. Los senadores fijaron el 30 de noviembre como plazo para confirmar dicha conservación.

fr.headline: Des sénateurs américains ordonnent à Musk de conserver les documents de SpaceX sur l'accès à Starlink en Ukraine
fr.body: Les sénateurs démocrates américains Jeanne Shaheen et Chris Coons ont demandé à Elon Musk de conserver les documents relatifs aux restrictions imposées par SpaceX sur les services Starlink et Starshield en Ukraine. Selon certaines informations, les forces ukrainiennes ont déclaré que le système de qualité militaire Starshield est essentiel pour les communications sur la ligne de front et les opérations de drones. Les sénateurs ont fixé au 30 novembre la date limite pour confirmer cette conservation.

it.headline: Senatori statunitensi ordinano a Musk di conservare i documenti di SpaceX sull'accesso a Starlink in Ucraina
it.body: I senatori democratici statunitensi Jeanne Shaheen e Chris Coons hanno intimato a Elon Musk di conservare i documenti relativi alle restrizioni imposte da SpaceX ai servizi Starlink e Starshield in Ucraina. Secondo quanto riportato, le forze ucraine hanno dichiarato che il sistema di livello militare Starshield è fondamentale per le comunicazioni in prima linea e per le operazioni con i droni. I senatori hanno fissato al 30 novembre il termine ultimo per la conferma dell'avvenuta conservazione.

de.headline: US-Senatoren fordern Musk zur Aufbewahrung von SpaceX-Aufzeichnungen über Starlink-Zugang der Ukraine auf
de.body: Die demokratischen US-Senatoren Jeanne Shaheen und Chris Coons haben Elon Musk aufgefordert, Aufzeichnungen im Zusammenhang mit den Einschränkungen von SpaceX bei den ukrainischen Diensten Starlink und Starshield aufzubewahren. Berichten zufolge erklärten ukrainische Streitkräfte, das militärtaugliche Starshield-System sei für die Kommunikation an der Front und Drohneneinsätze unverzichtbar. Die Senatoren setzten eine Frist bis zum 30. November für die Bestätigung der Aufbewahrung.

zh.headline: 美国参议员要求马斯克保留SpaceX有关乌克兰星链服务的记录
zh.body: 美国民主党参议员珍妮·沙欣（Jeanne Shaheen）和克里斯·孔斯（Chris Coons）要求埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）保留与SpaceX限制乌克兰星链（Starlink）及星盾（Starshield）服务相关的记录。据报道，乌克兰军队表示，军用级星盾系统对于前线通信和无人机作战至关重要。参议员们已设定11月30日为确认保留记录的截止日期。

ja.headline: 米上院議員、マスク氏にウクライナのスターリンク利用に関するスペースXの記録保存を要求
ja.body: 米民主党のジーン・シャヒーン、クリス・クーンズ両上院議員はイーロン・マスク氏に対し、ウクライナにおけるスペースXの「スターリンク」および「スターシールド」サービスの制限に関連する記録を保存するよう求めた。報道によると、ウクライナ軍は軍事用スターシールド・システムが前線での通信やドローン運用に不可欠であると述べている。両議員は11月30日を記録保存の確認期限としている。

pt.headline: Senadores dos EUA ordenam a Musk que preserve registos de acesso Starlink da Ucrânia na SpaceX
pt.body: Senadores democratas dos EUA, Jeanne Shaheen e Chris Coons, pediram a Elon Musk que preserve registos relacionados com as restrições da SpaceX aos serviços Starlink e Starshield da Ucrânia. Forças ucranianas afirmaram que o sistema Starshield militar é vital para comunicações de linha da frente e operações de drones, segundo relatórios. Os senadores fixaram um prazo de 30 de novembro para a confirmação da preservação.

ko.headline: 미 상원 의원들, 우크라이나 스타링크 접근 관련 스페이스X 기록 보존 지시
ko.body: 미 민주당 상원의원 진 셰인과 크리스 쿠운스는 일론 머스크에게 우크라이나의 스타링크 및 스타쉴드 서비스에 대한 스페이스X의 제한과 관련된 기록을 보존하라고 요청했다. 보고서에 따르면 우크라이나군은 군용 등급의 스타쉴드 시스템이 최전선 통신 및 드론 작전에 필수적이라고 밝혔다. 상원 의원들은 11월 30일까지 보존 확인을 기한으로 정했다.

en.headline: White House confirms upcoming trilateral summit in China
en.body: US President Donald Trump will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen on November 19, according to the White House. US officials stated that discussions will focus on nuclear arms reduction and the war against Iran, while talks on Ukraine will continue separately.

es.headline: La Casa Blanca confirma próxima cumbre trilateral en China
es.body: El presidente de EE. UU., Donald Trump, se reunirá con el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, y el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, en Shenzhen el 19 de noviembre, según la Casa Blanca. Funcionarios estadounidenses afirmaron que los debates se centrarán en la reducción de armas nucleares y la guerra contra Irán, mientras que las conversaciones sobre Ucrania continuarán por separado.

fr.headline: La Maison Blanche confirme la tenue d'un prochain sommet trilatéral en Chine
fr.body: Le président américain Donald Trump rencontrera le président russe Vladimir Poutine et le président chinois Xi Jinping à Shenzhen le 19 novembre, selon la Maison Blanche. Les responsables américains ont déclaré que les discussions se concentreraient sur la réduction des armements nucléaires et la guerre contre l'Iran, tandis que les pourparlers sur l'Ukraine se poursuivront séparément.

it.headline: La Casa Bianca conferma l'imminente vertice trilaterale in Cina
it.body: Il presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump incontrerà il presidente russo Vladimir Putin e il presidente cinese Xi Jinping a Shenzhen il 19 novembre, secondo quanto comunicato dalla Casa Bianca. I funzionari statunitensi hanno dichiarato che le discussioni si concentreranno sulla riduzione degli armamenti nucleari e sulla guerra contro l'Iran, mentre i colloqui sull'Ucraina proseguiranno separatamente.

de.headline: Weißes Haus bestätigt bevorstehenden trilateralen Gipfel in China
de.body: US-Präsident Donald Trump wird nach Angaben des Weißen Hauses am 19. November in Shenzhen mit dem russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin und dem chinesischen Präsidenten Xi Jinping zusammentreffen. US-Beamte erklärten, die Gespräche würden sich auf die Reduzierung nuklearer Waffen und den Krieg gegen den Iran konzentrieren, während die Gespräche über die Ukraine separat fortgesetzt würden.

zh.headline: 白宫确认即将于中国举行三方峰会
zh.body: 据白宫消息，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）将于11月19日在深圳与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（Vladimir Putin）及中国国家主席习近平举行会晤。美国官员表示，讨论重点将集中在核裁军及针对伊朗的战争，而关于乌克兰的会谈将另行进行。

ja.headline: ホワイトハウス、中国での3カ国首脳会談の開催を確認
ja.body: ホワイトハウスによると、ドナルド・トランプ米大統領は11月19日に中国の深センで、ロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン大統領および中国の習近平国家主席と会談する。米当局者は、議論の焦点は核軍縮と対イラン戦争になると述べ、ウクライナに関する協議は別途継続されるとした。

pt.headline: Casa Branca confirma próximo cimeira trilateral na China
pt.body: O Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, reunirá-se com o Presidente russo Vladimir Putin e o Presidente chinês Xi Jinping em Shenzhen a 19 de novembro, segundo a Casa Branca. Funcionários dos EUA declararam que as discussões focar-se-ão na redução de armas nucleares e na guerra contra o Irão, enquanto as conversações sobre a Ucrânia continuarão separadamente.

ko.headline: 백악관, 중국에서 예정된 3자 정상회담 확인
ko.body: 백악관에 따르면 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 11월 19일 선전에서 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령 및 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 만날 예정이다. 미 관리들은 논의가 핵무기 감축과 이란 전쟁에 초점을 맞출 것이며, 우크라이나에 대한 논의는 별도로 계속될 것이라고 밝혔다.
